directness_notes: Direct HSV-1 null-mutant evidence; not direct HSV-2 evidence.

experimental_system: mutational replication assay and purified enzyme assay
finding: Conserved-region substitutions failed to support origin-dependent DNA replication; a catalytic substitution abolished primase activity.
source_title: Helicase-primase complex of herpes simplex virus type 1: a mutation in the UL52 subunit abolishes primase activity

experimental_system: gK-null viruses in replicating and stationary cultured cells
finding: gK-null virus produced infectious virus in actively replicating cells but showed major egress defects and about 100000-fold lower yield in stationary cells.
source_title: Herpes simplex virus type 1 glycoprotein K is not essential for infectious virus production in actively replicating cells but is required for efficient envelopment and translocation

experimental_system: truncation mutants and origin-dependent DNA replication assay
finding: C-terminal UL30 sequences required for UL42 interaction were required for origin-dependent viral DNA replication despite retained polymerase activity on an activated template.
